name: AutoBot
description: Cube bot with step-aligned exact search, committed plans, measured physics, prediction audit and death forensics.

horizon.name: Lookahead (frames at 60 fps)
horizon.description: How far ahead the planner simulates. 60 is about 1 s. Works at any FPS/TPS.

beam-width.name: Search budget
beam-width.description: Max simulated steps per search = this value x 1500 (also capped at 2 ms per search).

hazard-margin.name: Hazard safety margin (units)
hazard-margin.description: Spikes are treated as this much bigger. Raise it if the bot clips spikes.

learn-from-deaths.name: Learn from deaths
learn-from-deaths.description: After a crash, remember the bad click position and avoid clicking there again (session only).

debug-draw.name: Draw debug overlay
debug-draw.description: Red = hazards, blue = blocks, yellow = orbs/pads, purple = portals, orange = unsupported objects, green/white line = planned path (white = click).

use-orbs.name: Click orbs
use-orbs.description: Let the planner click orbs when the player touches them.
